scope: Successful observed method_seconds remain primary. Explicit estimated_method_seconds are declared unmeasured assumptions; missing cases use the conservative fallback. Grouping only: every source-discovered method executes exactly once.
selection_policy: Most recent successful XCTest case completion in runs 62 and 63; run 63 takes precedence. Failed observations do not replace successful or historical weights. Retain prior runs 54/55 values for methods without a recent successful observation, then use unobserved_method_seconds for source-discovered methods absent from the profile. Case duration excludes Xcode setup and result finalization; estimates are not process-deadline guarantees.

estimate_provenance.basis: Conservative grouping assumptions, not executed case timings. Successful measurements take priority. 23 original assumptions plus explicitly scoped later additions.
